verses.1: And after these things, he said to Joseph, “Look! Your father is sick.” He took his two sons with him, along with Manasseh and Ephraim.
verses.2: And he told Jacob, “Look, your son Joseph is coming to see you. Israel will become stronger, and he will sit on the throne.”
verses.3: And Jacob said to Joseph, “Look, there’s a place in the land of Canaan where I can find shelter. May God bless me there.”
verses.4: And he said to me, “I will make you fruitful and multiply you. I will give you land for your descendants to possess forever.”
verses.5: And now, your two sons who were born in the land of Egypt, until they come back to you from Egypt. They will be Ephraim and Manasseh. Reuben and Simeon will be their names.
verses.6: And those who were born after you will be called by the name of their ancestors in their own land.
verses.7: And I will come from Paddan Aram to Rachel in the land of Canaan. On my way there, I will pass by Efrata. There, I will meet her along the road to Efrata. That is the house of Labah.
verses.8: And Israel saw the sons of Joseph, and he said, “Who are these?”
verses.9: And Joseph said to his father, “These are the sons I have received from God.” Then he said, “Please take them from me, and bless them.”
verses.10: And the eyes of Israel were dimmed from seeing, so they could not see anything. He brought them to him, hugged them, and comforted them.
verses.11: And Israel said to Joseph, “Look at your face! I have not sinned. Now, God has seen me, and He also sees your descendants.”
verses.12: And Joseph brought them out from their place with his blessings. They bowed down to his feet.
verses.13: And Joseph took both of them—Ephraim on his right hand, and Manasseh on his left hand. He gathered them together from the tribes of Israel.
verses.14: And Israel sent their right-handers to attack Efraim. The younger one was given the task of attacking Manasseh. Manasseh had his arms covered with armor.
verses.15: And He blessed Joseph, and said, “The God who caused my ancestors Abraham and Isaac to walk before me, that God will also bless me until this very day.”
verses.16: The Angel of Salvation will protect me from all evil. He will bless the boys and call them by my name, as well as the names of my ancestors: Abraham and Isaac. They will be blessed greatly in the midst of the earth.
verses.17: And Joseph saw that his father’s right hand was on the head of Ephraim. He became angry in his eyes, and he tried to remove his father’s hand from the head of Ephraim.
verses.18: And Joseph said to his father, “No, my father! This is the one who will place his right hand on your head.”
verses.19: And his father said, “I know, my son. I know that he will also become a great person. But his younger brother will grow up to be greater than him. And his descendants will become the most important people in the world.”
verses.20: And on that day, He blessed them, saying, “In you, Israel, I will bless you.” He said also, “God will make you like Ephraim and Manasseh.” And He placed Ephraim before Manasseh.
verses.21: And Israel said to Joseph, “Look, I am dying. But God will be with you, and He will bring you back to the land of your ancestors.”
verses.22: And I have given you one share for each of your brothers, those whom I took from the Amorites during my conquests and battles.
